name: O2
note: O2 is a brand of Virgin Media O2, a 50/50 joint venture of Telefónica and Liberty Global. Telefónica's significant shareholders include stc (Saudi Arabia, 9.97%), which has a director on Telefónica's board, SEPI (Spain, 10.00%) and CriteriaCaixa (see the cited ownership claims). Along the chain stc's share of O2 is about 4.99%, just under the 5% test; whether a board seat at the 50% parent counts as a board seat under METHOD.md is for a maintainer. Until then the rating is on hold.
